name: Midas Fasanara Global
oneLiner: mGLOBAL is a Midas tokenized certificate wrapping Fasanara's global private-credit and strategy portfolio; NAV-accreting, EEA-restricted rails.
collateral: Tokenized exposure to Fasanara's Global Fund (same strategy as the Global Diversified Alternative Debt Fund): an asset-backed lending portfolio investing primarily in short-dated trade receivables and digital invoices purchased from SMEs, held via Midas tokenized-certificate rails.
pegMechanism: NAV-accreting Midas tokenized certificate; primary issuance and redemption occur through Midas permissioned rails rather than a fixed $1 peg.

proofOfReserves.provider: Midas Attestation Engine: on-chain NAV/proof-of-reserves/price, independently verified via Chainlink, Canary, LlamaRisk and vLayer

jurisdiction.license: Luxembourg securitisation note issued by Aureum Securitisation Fund (Compartment mGLOBAL) under Luxembourg securitisation law; NAV calculated monthly by independent administrator JTC Luxembourg; EEA-restricted, not available to U.S. retail persons.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes: Midas Fasanara Global is a permissioned tokenized certificate with issuer/admin control surfaces around minting, redemption, transfer administration, and upgradeable protocol contracts.

reserveReview.rationale: Midas identifies mGLOBAL as a tokenized strategy tracking Fasanara Capital's Global Diversified Alternative Debt strategy, a portfolio of short-duration investment-grade asset-backed credit sourced from SMEs across more than 60 countries.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Midas issuer disclosure of the Fasanara Global Diversified Alternative Debt strategy
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The issuer does not publish a current loan tape, receivable-level weights, obligor concentrations, warehouse facilities, custody providers, valuation inputs, or liquidity schedule. The full portfolio remains one disclosed private-credit strategy envelope.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The issuer identifies the strategy envelope but does not publish a current underlying portfolio allocation or individual obligor and counterparty exposures.

notices.title: Contract-priced strategy token
notices.message: CoinGecko reports a live price and market cap but little or no secondary-market volume; Pharos treats MGLOBAL as a NAV-priced tokenized certificate.

mintAuthority.summary: mGLOBAL has two live direct-minter controls on Ethereum: backend EOA 0x76e350c5a674db787918e5f728466c7356d4d361 and DepositVault proxy 0xce29c36c6d4556f2d01d79414c1354b968dddef1. A 1-of-3 Safe and a separate EOA can immediately rotate mint operators through DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. The token, vault, and shared MidasAccessControl proxies share a ProxyAdmin owned by a two-day timelock.

upgradeability.controlRef: Midas Ethereum upgrade path - 1/3 Safe through 2-day timelock

controls.label: mGLOBAL mint operator EOA
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527148, MidasAccessControl role-state reconstruction and live role checks identified 0x76e350c5a674db787918e5f728466c7356d4d361 as the current mGLOBAL direct-minter EOA.

controls.label: mGLOBAL DepositVault proxy
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527148, DepositVault proxy 0xce29c36c6d4556f2d01d79414c1354b968dddef1 remained a live mGLOBAL direct minter; its EIP-1967 implementation was 0x08e4432f84e660235821c63764fb2ffcc7e2b477.

controls.label: Midas Ethereum DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE Safe
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527148, Safe 0xb60842e9dabcd1c52e354ac30e82a97661cb7e89 held DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on MidasAccessControl and could grant or revoke the mGLOBAL mint-operator role immediately. This direct role-admin path is distinct from the Safe's two-day timelocked proxy-upgrade path.

controls.label: Midas Ethereum DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE EOA
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527148, EOA 0xd4195cf4df289a4748c1a7b6ddbe770e27ba1227 also held DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and could grant or revoke the mGLOBAL mint-operator role without delay.

controls.label: Midas Ethereum upgrade path - 1/3 Safe through 2-day timelock
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527148, all three mint-critical transparent proxies shared ProxyAdmin 0xbf25b58cb8dfad688f7bcb2b87d71c23a6600aac. Its owner was MidasTimelockController 0xe3eee3e0d2398799c884a47fc40c029c8e241852 with a 172800-second delay. Safe 0xb60842e9dabcd1c52e354ac30e82a97661cb7e89 was the timelock's sole proposer, executor, and canceller; it was 1-of-3 with no enabled modules and a zero guard.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527148, the current mGLOBAL direct minters were EOA 0x76e350c5a674db787918e5f728466c7356d4d361 and DepositVault proxy 0xce29c36c6d4556f2d01d79414c1354b968dddef1. The previously recorded EOA 0x425bbc2cff0c7e7960baa9bac2f0cb67b41d3bef and address 0xd36f095556d5717fd9231a2091e8e98beb7cb621 were not live mGLOBAL mint controls; 0xd36f095556d5717fd9231a2091e8e98beb7cb621 is unrelated to the current vault. Safe 0xb60842e9dabcd1c52e354ac30e82a97661cb7e89 and EOA 0xd4195cf4df289a4748c1a7b6ddbe770e27ba1227 each held DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and could immediately change the role set. The complete mint-critical proxy inventory was token 0x7433806912eae67919e66aea853d46fa0aef98a8, DepositVault 0xce29c36c6d4556f2d01d79414c1354b968dddef1, and shared MidasAccessControl 0x0312a9d1ff2372ddedcbb21e4b6389afc919ac4b, with implementations 0xd22be883b7194ac2d1751bf8e6e4962d87f2f75a, 0x08e4432f84e660235821c63764fb2ffcc7e2b477, and 0xdd5a54ba2ab379a5e642c58f98ad793a183960e2 respectively. Each EIP-1967 admin slot resolved to ProxyAdmin 0xbf25b58cb8dfad688f7bcb2b87d71c23a6600aac, owned by the 172800-second Midas timelock. The timelock's sole initiating Safe was 1-of-3 with no enabled modules and a zero guard. Economic-control evidence reviewed 2026-07-15: JTC Luxembourg independently values the mGLOBAL underlying assets monthly, with the latest product period shown as 2026-05-01 through 2026-05-31; the Midas engine notarizes and independently verifies each checkpoint. The exempt Luxembourg securitisation compartment is not evidenced as a prudentially supervised fund.
